skill_name: Summarize the impact of technology on the entertainment industry.
workflow: The introduction of modern technology has had a tremendous impact on the entertainment industry. Technology has enabled users to consume content more quickly, conveniently, and cost-effectively. It also has allowed for more interactive forms of entertainment, better sound and video quality, more creative story-telling capabilities, and more engaging forms of gaming.
